headline: K-pop Blind Test 2026: Guess This Year’s Biggest Songs
description: The 2026 K-pop blind test, explained: which groups you will hear, how the 10-second guessing game works, and how to train your ear to name a song in the first two seconds.

itemListElement.name: K-pop Blind Test 2026: Guess This Year’s Biggest Songs

mainEntity.name: What is a K-pop blind test?

acceptedAnswer.text: A K-pop blind test is a listening game: you hear a short audio clip, usually around ten seconds, of a K-pop song with no title or video, then pick the right song or artist from four choices before the timer ends. It tests song recognition rather than trivia.

mainEntity.name: What makes a 2026 blind test different?

acceptedAnswer.text: A 2026 blind test leans on the groups charting this year, so the pool weights toward current comebacks and breakout rookies like Cortis, ILLIT and BABYMONSTER alongside the all-time hits from BTS, BLACKPINK, aespa and other established groups. The questions shift with the year even when the game stays the same.

mainEntity.name: Is the K-pop blind test free to play?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The KpopQuiz.org blind test is free and needs no account. You can start a round instantly and play the full mixed mode, a single generation, or one group at a time.

mainEntity.name: Can I play the blind test for just one group?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Any group with enough songs in the catalog has its own blind test playlist, so you can practise a single group like BTS, BLACKPINK or Stray Kids before attempting the mixed all-K-pop round.
